transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… mostly I’m here because I’ve been feeling really tired. Not just normal tired—like I can sleep and still feel like I’m starting the day with a low battery. I’m still getting through work, but it doesn’t feel right.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… I suppose so. It’s been more of a long, gray kind of feeling most days. Things I used to look forward to—fishing, the garden, even church concerts—just feel like… something to get through.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?

Not really, no. I mean… I still do them sometimes—fishing, messing with the tomatoes, going to a church concert—but for a long time now it’s felt kind of gray and flat. More like checking something off than actually enjoying it.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
I don’t think so… not especially. I mean, I can be hard on myself about things, but I wouldn’t say guilt is a big part of it lately.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Not really… I mean, no more than usual, I guess. I haven’t noticed feeling especially on edge.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
Maybe a little, but not much. Fishing or working on the tomatoes… even a church concert now and then. I do them, but it’s mostly just kind of flat. Like I’m going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been… a little over two years, I guess. Since I got pulled back into running operations full-time. About two years and four months.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live or hurting yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get worn down, but I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?
Yeah… a little, I guess. I’m not trying to lose weight, but my appetite’s been off. I’ll skip lunch without really noticing, then just pick at dinner. My wife said my pants look looser.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling like it's harder to get things done physically?
Not really… I mean, I get things done. Maybe I’m slower to start sometimes, but physically? I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt really good, like the opposite of how you've been feeling lately?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had better days, sure, but not some stretch where I felt unusually good or anything like that.
Has there been a significant event or loss in your life around the time when you started feeling this way, about two years and four months ago?
Not a loss, no. It was more… work. Around then I got pulled back into full operational leadership, and things have felt this way since. About two years and four months, I guess.
Have you had periods of significant depression like this before in your life?
I don’t know… not really like this, no. I’ve had rough stretches before, but I wouldn’t say they were the same.
Would you say your feelings of tiredness and lack of enjoyment in activities have been constant, or have they varied in intensity over the past two years?

It’s varied some, I guess… but the tiredness is pretty much always there. That’s mostly why I came in. I can sleep and still get through work, but I feel like I’m on a low battery before the day even starts.
Have your feelings of sadness and tiredness been with you for most of the day, every day, over the past two years?

Most days, yeah. It’s not always sharp sadness… more like this gray, flat feeling that hangs around. Things I used to look forward to—fishing, the tomatoes, even a church concert—just feel like things to get through.
Has this gray, flat feeling you've described lasted for at least two years without any periods of improvement?
Yeah… I’d say it’s been there since I got pulled back into full operational leadership. That was about two years and four months ago. I don’t think it’s really let up much since then.
Has this feeling of tiredness and lack of enjoyment in activities been present for most of every day?
Yeah… most of the day, I’d say. I can sleep and still get through work, but I feel like I’m on low battery before the day even really starts.
Has this gray, flat feeling you've described been continuous without any breaks for the past two years?
Yeah… pretty much. Since I got pulled back into full operational leadership—about two years and four months ago—it’s just kind of been there.
Has this feeling of tiredness and lack of enjoyment in activities been present for at least two years without any significant improvement?
Yeah. I mean… it’s been going on since I was pulled back into full operational leadership. About two years and four months now, I guess.
Has this feeling of tiredness and lack of enjoyment in activities been present for most of every day for at least two years?
Yes… most days, most of the day. It’s been that way since I got pulled back into full operational leadership—about two years and four months ago.
